tip: Venire plus a past participle forms the passive for actions: vengono prese means are taken or made.
Stare per plus an infinitive means to be about to do something: sta per cominciare = is about to start.
Pur plus a gerund means although or despite: pur essendo stanco = although being tired.
Come se takes the imperfect or pluperfect subjunctive, never the present: come se fossero = as if they were.
